description: Prepare a user-supplied collector event template or personal preparation card, with explicit wanted/offered names, source matches, Markdown and a reviewable share link. Supports participant swaps, store-only swaps or display-only rules. Does not verify the organizer, event, ownership, matches or trades. The link contains readable user-supplied data: anyone holding it can read, edit or forward it. Review before sharing; expired cards are read-only. No browser storage access or automatic publication.

eventDate.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD as supplied for the event; no attendance or timing verification.

language.description: Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE.

offered.description: Only items explicitly offered; prohibited in display-only mode. Repeated names do not establish quantities.

rulesUrl.description: Optional user-supplied HTTPS rules link; not fetched or verified.

wanted.description: Explicit names only, preferably Series title / figure name. Unknown names remain unresolved; no inferred trade intent.

name: prepare_swap_event_card
